desc:
💎 GRAU FX 💎

The ultimate Venezuelan motorcycle game on Roblox! Get ready, give it your all, and perform the best tricks. Speed through the streets, dominate the asphalt, and prove who is the real tough one on a single wheel.

🎮 HOW TO PLAY?

Accelerate: W

Brake: S

Cross: A / D

Little Horse: Shift

🪖 COMMANDS

/char → Load and dress up your favorite Roblox character.

📌 NOTE:

The game is in development (Beta). If you find any errors or bugs, please let us know so we can fix them. Thank you for supporting the project and enjoying the party!
